Answer: C
Reason: The frontal chest X-ray (Figure 1a) shows a large, dense opacity in the right upper lung zone that has convex medial and lateral borders, suggesting an extrapulmonary (mediastinal or chest wall) origin rather than an intrapulmonary one. The lateral view (Figure 1b) confirms the mass is located anteriorly in the upper thorax, consistent with an anterior mediastinal mass situated anterior to the vertebral column.
